'''Haitong International Securities Group Limited''' known as '''Haitong International''' is an international financial institution with established presence in Hong Kong and a rapidly expanding network across the globe. It strives to serve as a bridge linking up the Chinese and overseas capital markets. The parent company of Haitong International is Guotai Haitong Securities Co., Ltd (“Guotai Haitong Securities”).

It was known as '''Tai Fook Securities''' which was owned by [[Chow Tai Fook]]–[[New World Development]] group until 2009.

==History==
===Tai Fook Securities era===
When the firm was known as Tai Fook Securities, it was accused that the firm lowered its commission below [[Stock Exchange of Hong Kong]]'s minimum, by gifts from sister companies [[Chow Tai Fook Jewellery]] and [[New World Telephone]] in 1999.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.scmp.com/article/286531/tai-fook-denies-gift-scheme-breaks-rule-commission-rate|title=Tai Fook denies gift scheme breaks rule on commission rate|date=29 June 1999|access-date=8 November 2018|newspaper=South China Morning Post|location=Hong Kong|language=en-hk}}</ref>
===Haitong International Securities Group era===
Tai Fook Securities was then takeover by the Chinese firm [[Haitong Securities]] in 2009. Haitong Securities paid HK$1.82 billion to acquire the controlling stake of Tai Fook Securities from [[NWS Holdings]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2009-11/23/content_9023774.htm|title=China's Haitong Securities to buy Hong Kong broker|date=23 November 2009|newspaper=China Daily|agency=Xinhua News Agency|publication-place=Beijing|location=Shanghai|access-date=14 June 2019}}</ref> After the takeover, Tai Fook Securities was renamed to Haitong International Securities Group.

Haitong International is the first{{not in source|date=June 2019}} Chinese financial institution in Hong Kong to have been assigned a “BBB” long-term credit rating by [[Standard and Poor's]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.alacrastore.com/s-and-p-credit-research/Outlook-On-Haitong-Securities-And-Haitong-International-Securities-Revised-To-Negative-BBB-A-2-Ratings-Affirmed-1454109|title=Outlook On Haitong Securities And Haitong International Securities Revised To Negative; 'BBB/A-2' Ratings Affirmed|website=alacrastore.com|access-date=14 June 2019}} </ref> In November 2016 Haitong International Securities acquired Haitong Securities India from [[Haitong Bank]], a sister company that formerly known as Banco Espírito Santo de Investimento.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.globalcapital.com/article/b10c092mnm90lq/haitong-boosts-apac-operations-with-india-acquisitionl|title=Haitong Boosts Apac Operations with India Acquisition|website=globalcapital.com|date=10 November 2016|access-date=14 June 2019|url-access=limited}}</ref>
